monthly.title: Recurring Bills
monthly.intro: Create once, organize each month and record real payments.
monthly.onboarding: Choose or add a bank or cash account to record bill payments. An optional monthly budget is only a plan; it does not replace that account.
monthly.accountHelp: A financial account tells Monize where payments come from. Add your bank or cash account here to continue without leaving your bill.
monthly.balanceHelp: Enter the actual starting balance you want to record, including zero if appropriate. This is separate from your monthly budget.
monthly.budgetHelp: Enter the initial allocation for the entire month, including bills already paid. This is planning only: it creates no income, changes no bank balance and does not carry into the next month. Expected remainder equals this budget minus the month total.
monthly.paymentHelp: This records a real financial transaction for this occurrence only. A payment entered separately in Transactions is not linked automatically. Do not record it again here.
monthly.name: Name
monthly.saveFailed: Could not save. Review the error and refresh before trying again.
monthly.loadFailed: Could not load this month. Try again.
monthly.empty: No tracked bills in this month
monthly.emptyHelp: Add a monthly bill or start tracking an existing schedule. History before tracking begins is not reconstructed.
monthly.historyStarts: {name}: tracked from {date}. Earlier history is unavailable.
monthly.blockedPayment: This occurrence already has a payment link. Review its transaction in Transactions before making any correction; another payment is blocked.
monthly.missingRate: No {from} → {to} rate for {date}. Add or refresh the rate in Currencies to calculate the affected totals.
monthly.unknownBills: Review these bills and their linked transactions: {names}. Their complete totals are unavailable.
monthly.adoptHelp: Start tracking the current outstanding occurrence and the months after it. Existing schedules are reused. Earlier payments are not reconstructed; verify that the current occurrence has not already been paid separately.
